summary: Gives operators recommendations for running Segment Routing LSPs alongside RSVP-TE LSPs in the same network, including while services migrate from one to the other. It discusses how the two can coexist, including sharing links and bandwidth, and what to watch out for during the transition.

eli5.summary: A town is adding a new bus system while the old one still runs. This explains how both can share the same roads without crashing into each other.

questions: migrate from rsvp-te to segment routing
